info.name: Stewardex API
info.description:
Auto-generated from the Express routes (618 endpoints across 60 modules).

Setup:
1. Import this collection AND Stewardex.postman_environment.json.
2. Select the "Stewardex — Local" environment (top-right).
3. Run Auth › Login — it captures the JWT into {{token}} + {{org_id}}.
4. Every other request then sends Authorization: Bearer {{token}} and the x-org-id header automatically.

POST/PUT/PATCH bodies are skeletons built from express-validator body() fields where detectable — fill in real values.

Regenerate with: node postman/generate-postman.mjs
